page: Vultr vcg-a40-6c-30g-12vram is a virtual machine instance within the Cloud GPU family. It is configured with 6 dedicated Intel x86_64 vCPUs, 30.0 GB of system memory, and 550 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address and allocates 5.0 GB of system memory per CPU core.

The instance features a fractional NVIDIA Ampere A40 GPU, representing a 0.25 slice of the physical graphics processor. This allocation provides 12 GB of dedicated VRAM. This fractional setup enables workloads to utilize hardware-accelerated compute and graphics capabilities without requiring a full, dedicated GPU.

By partitioning the physical GPU, this server provides a cost-efficient option for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not need a full 48 GB frame buffer. It is suitable for workloads such as machine learning inference, data processing, video transcoding, and GPU-accelerated development environments.
